state.goal:
Resolve this issue: Sort default settings

Keys in scrapy/settings/default_settings.py have several order problems, both between groups and inside groups.

Sorting keys in a group may be controversial though, as it seems may of them are ordered by important, e.g. FOO_ENABLED between other FOO_* and FTP_USER before FTP_PASSWORD. I'm fine with keeping these occasional violations (not all violations though, e.g. even if FOO_ENABLED comes first, other keys should normally be sorted) if the file header is modified to mention that.
